q: In the merchant-risk project, what is mrisk-gbm-v3?
a: The current merchant-level fraud risk model (2026-10-08): gradient-boosted trees on the merchant-month panel using chargeback ratio, card concentration, new-merchant flag, MCC base rate and the dispute ratio from dispute-triage. It reaches AUC 0.91 and precision@100 0.58 on mrisk-oot-2026h1 (exp-507).

q: What came of the watchlist cut test in merchant-risk (exp-506)?
a: exp-506 (2026-07-21) showed a 0.70 score flags 4.1% of merchants and captures 63% of confirmed-fraud merchants at 0.31 precision. dec-mrisk-watchlist-07 adopted 0.70, and exp-508 then moved the cut to 0.65 (mrisk-find-watchlist-065, dec-mrisk-threshold-065).

q: What does mrisk-gbm-v2 depend on in the merchant-risk project?
a: mrisk-gbm-v2 uses feat-mrisk-cb-ratio-90d, feat-mrisk-txn-concentration, feat-mrisk-new-merchant and feat-mrisk-mcc-base on the ds-mrisk-merchant-month panel, with confirmed-fraud labels from ds-mrisk-chargebacks.

q: What watchlist cut does the merchant-risk project use now?
a: 0.65 on mrisk-gbm-v3 (dec-mrisk-threshold-065, 2026-10-02), which replaced the 0.70 cut of dec-mrisk-watchlist-07. It flags 5.2% of merchants and captures 74% of confirmed-fraud merchants (exp-508).

q: What AUC and precision@100 did mrisk-gbm-v2 reach on mrisk-oot-2026h1?
a: AUC 0.86 and precision@100 0.43 on mrisk-oot-2026h1 (Jan-Mar 2026 merchant-months), evaluated 2026-07-06 in exp-505.

q: Why was the dispute ratio added to the merchant-risk model?
a: dec-mrisk-dispute-feature (2026-09-30): exp-507 showed feat-mrisk-dispute-ratio, borrowed from dispute-triage, lifts mrisk-oot-2026h1 AUC from 0.86 (v2) to 0.91 (v3), so mrisk-gbm-v3 was built with it.
